The '''1965 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 21st completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].
{{TOC limit|2}}

==Overview==
The season was contested by 10 teams, and [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerengen]] won their first championship. 

Vålerenga's 27 points was at the time a record for most points in a season, one more than [[Lyn Fotball|Lyn]] achieved in the previous season. [[Viking FK|Viking]] and [[Sandefjord BK]] were relegated to the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]].
